exempt.no-bespoke-react-native-interactions: client/host-ui.tsx is the local composition that replaces the deleted paseo-plugin-helper/ui adapters for top (xpufx-org/paseo#937, #924). The host SDK exposes no button/toggle/tab pressable primitive, so the presentation layer must compose Pressable over react-native. Every other helper/UI rule is followed; this is the single interaction seam.
